ui.settings.voice.label: Session voice
ui.settings.voice.description: Lets you talk to a conversation hands-free. Off by default. While it is off, nothing for voice runs: no microphone, no speech models and no background checks. Turning it on adds a voice button to the composer; turning it off stops voice at once and releases the microphone.
ui.settings.voice.local_note: The first time, it downloads about 330 MB of speech models, once. Speech then runs on this computer.
